name: Sand Tarts
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Cream the butter, add sugar gradually, and egg well beaten; then add flour mixed and sifted with baking powder.
Chill, toss one-half mixture on a floured board, and roll one-eighth inch thick.
Brush over with white of egg, and sprinkle with sugar mixed with cinnamon.
Split almonds, and arrange three halves on each at equal distances.
Place on a buttered sheet, and bake eight minutes in a slow oven.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
